frequency_question: How often do executive fiscal principals successfully scale their announced intervention programs to meet or exceed their planned volume targets within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes major debt management scaling initiatives, Supplementary Financing Program expansions, and quantitative easing/tightening operational volume targets set by the Treasury or Fed where leadership explicitly stated intended operational sizes. Excludes purely legislative mandates where the executive lacked unilateral discretion.

cases.name: 2024 U.S. Treasury Regular Buyback Program rollout

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named; exhaustive for major discretionary U.S. debt/buyback operational volume scaling initiatives of this specific administrative class since 2008.
known_gaps: Minor technical adjustments to smaller repo operations omitted due to scale, but would not alter the fundamental rate of administrative follow-through.
validity_reason: The institutional mechanisms and executive authorities governing U.S. Treasury debt management operations remain stable across administrations.
